description: This file defines an enumeration 'ScheduledEmailAttachmentFileFormat' representing different file formats (INVALID, XLS, PDF, CSV) for email attachment files in the Fineract project. It includes methods to get instances based on string value or integer id, and provides accessors for each format's code, value, and id.

classes.name: ScheduledEmailAttachmentFileFormat
classes.description: Enumeration of supported email attachment file formats with utility methods for instance retrieval and validation.

methods.name: instance(String value)
methods.description: Returns the corresponding enum instance based on the provided string value (e.g., 'xls', 'pdf', 'csv').

methods.name: instance(Integer id)
methods.description: Returns the corresponding enum instance based on the provided integer id.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code associated with the format.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the string value associated with the format.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the integer id associated with the format.

methods.name: validValues
methods.description: Returns an array of the valid format ids.
